title: Transcenlutions Arcade
storage: Browser/WebView local storage only. No cloud synchronization.
accountEntitlements: Not implemented or required for this freely accessible prototype. This does not grant account or admin authority.
instructions: Open the entry point, choose a game and use its How to play control. Settings provides larger text, contrast, reduced motion and sound. Progress offers a portable JSON export.

compatibility.web: Modern browsers with JavaScript and ES modules. No external runtime assets. Service worker offline caching is scoped to the arcade path.
compatibility.standaloneHtml: Generated with npm run build:arcade. One file with all styles, game code, and assets embedded. Local saving depends on browser file-origin behavior.
compatibility.android: API 26+ wrapper with bundled assets; API 36 target. Test APK uses debug signing; unsigned AAB requires production signing. Actual device behavior must be tested.
compatibility.agentChats: Authorized agents can reference the product contract, code, gameplay instructions and JSON export. No automatic authenticated account-library integration or universal in-chat runtime is claimed.
compatibility.androidExport: Copyable JSON text is shown in the app because native blob downloads are not enabled. Browser edition offers a JSON file.

monetization: No ads, purchases, payment SDK, or price configured. Commercial release terms require a separate verified setup.
provenance: Original code and geometric visuals developed for Transcenlutions. Common genre mechanics informed by a dated market study; no competitor code, artwork, audio, level data, logos or descriptions included.
publication: Track build, preview, Android test and Google Play release separately in docs/releases/arcade-2026-10-17.md.
